description: A GWT-based Java class implementing the view component for a ToDo application, managing UI elements, event handling, and routing logic.

classes.name: ToDoView
classes.description: A GWT Composite class implementing the ToDo application's view, managing UI components, event wiring, and routing.

methods.name: ToDoView
methods.description: Constructor initializing UI components, setting element IDs, and configuring the view.

methods.name: getTaskText
methods.description: Returns the current text in the task input field.

methods.name: addhandler
methods.description: Binds UI events (click, keyup) to the provided event handler.

methods.name: setDataProvider
methods.description: Associates a data provider with the todo table display.

methods.name: setTaskStatistics
methods.description: Updates task count display and UI element visibility based on total and completed tasks.

methods.name: setRouting
methods.description: Updates routing hyperlink styles based on current routing state.
